professionalSummary: Three‑year experience as a Pricing Analyst in a personal lines motor pricing team, responsible for refreshing rating factors, preparing rate change proposals, monitoring pricing models, and producing monthly pricing packs for the pricing committee.
experienceHighlights: Refreshed rating factors from claims and quote data each quarter following the team’s refresh procedure; prepared eleven rate change proposals with impact analysis, all approved or amended by the pricing committee; ran monthly pricing model monitoring and raised three drift cases to the actuarial team; prepared monthly pricing packs, clearly delineating analyst and actuarial contributions; documented limitations and hand‑over conditions for each proposal.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample includes a complete rate change proposal with impact analysis and committee decision record, a monthly pricing pack, and a monitoring log extract for the three drift cases, all linked to the pricing repository for verification.
skills: Documentation of limitations and hand‑over conditions
Collaboration with actuarial and underwriting teams
